```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -> clearcounters label="yes"
edge errorsfound -> escalate label="no"
edge clearcounters -> monitor
```

Change from the prior attempt: the two branch labels off `errorsfound` were passed as bare trailing strings (`"yes"` / `"no"`), which the validator rejected as unexpected arguments. Edge labels take the keyed form `label="..."` instead, so both lines now read `edge errorsfound -> clearcounters label="yes"` and `edge errorsfound -> escalate label="no"`. Everything else — the five ids, their kinds, and the four edges — is unchanged from the earlier draft.
